unit_note: EVERY frame figure in this file is at our fixed 60 Hz simulation step and is written f@60. A Souls community tick is t@30 and is a DIFFERENT UNIT: a Souls figure of N is 2N of ours (ARBITRATION S22). A frame count with no stated framerate is a defect.
provenance: Transcribed verbatim from corpus/10-combat/RI-CMB02 with the S22 rebase already applied. RI-CMB02 owns these NUMBERS; game/src/combat/** owns the MACHINE that runs them. A mismatch between this declaration and the observed trace is a hard fail (HARNESS.md §7 rule 4).
index_convention: Frame indices are 1-based and inclusive. first_active = startup + 1. Ps = startup + 1 (an INDEX, not a duration — S22 re-derives it, never doubles it).

derivations.hyperarmour_window: [ceil(0.60 * startup), startup + active]  — RI-CMB02 §B. ceil() does not commute with doubling, so these are re-derived from the rebased startups, never scaled.
derivations.commitment: STARTUP and ACTIVE are hard-committed. RECOVERY splits: the first ceil(0.45 * recovery) frames are hard, the remainder is DODGE-cancellable only. RI-CMB02 §D.
derivations.buffer: 8 f@60, one slot. NOT rebased — it is a wall-clock allowance for human input error (RI-CMB01 C6, RI-CMB09 §1).
derivations.min_startup_frames: 6 f@60 = 100 ms. NOT rebased — a property of human reaction time. §C startup multipliers clamp to it; post-rebase nothing clamps (RI-CMB02 §C boxed note).

heavy._source: RI-CMB02 §B. Hyperarmour windows re-derived from the formula, NOT scaled; the four marked ⚠ in the item disagree with a naive ×2 and are correct as written here.

modifiers._source: RI-CMB02 §C. Multipliers are dimensionless and did NOT move under S22; the base rows they multiply did.
modifiers._rounding: round-half-up to integer frames, applied ONCE, to the final product. startup_final = max(6, round(base * modifier)).

guard_counter._contradiction_declared: RI-CMB02 §C says 24 f@60; RI-WPN01/04/06 say 40 f@60. RI-WPN01's own cross-dependency clause says 'RI-CMB02 wins on frame values', so 24 stands here. Filed found-not-fixed in REBASE-S22-REPORT §7 — this build does not silently pick a different winner.

readability_contract._source: RI-CMB02 §E. Recomputed by tools/harness/cmb-probe.mjs --check=readability from the observed census, never trusted from this file.
readability_contract.adjacent_rule_scope: the 7-class spine of §A/§B only (RI-CMB02 §E ruling). The other 8 RI-WPN02 classes are separated by fingerprint distance, not timing.
